payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the Attention-Sum Reader model shows significant improvements when trained on the BookTest dataset compared to the original Children's Book Test (CBT) dataset.

claims.text: Training on the BookTest dataset improves the accuracy of the Attention-Sum Reader model on the CBT test data by a much larger margin than recent attempts to improve model architecture.

The model trained on the BookTest dataset reduces prediction error by almost one third compared to the original CBT training data, achieving human-level performance on the named-entity version of CBT.
Using the BookTest dataset provides a boost in performance that exceeds improvements achieved by enhancing model architecture alone.
